cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(llg_sim_runtime C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(MSVC)
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "/DNDEBUG")
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "/O2 /W3 ${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
else()
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "-DNDEBUG")
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-O3 -Wall -Wno-unused-function ${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
endif()

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()
set_source_files_properties(llg_co.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS LLG_CO_HOST_ALLOC=1)
add_library(llg_runtime STATIC llg_value.c llg_rng.c llg_co.c llg_rt.c llg_random.c llg_vpi.c llg_container.c llg_string.c)
target_include_directories(llg_runtime PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

add_compile_definitions(LLG_SV4_USE_GMP=0 LLG_SV4_GMP_KERNELS=0 LLG_VALUE_BUILD_CONFIG=1)
